status: Rejected; all compiler changes reverted before committing this evidence.
experiment: Emit f32x4 SIMD for retained vec2/vec3/vec4 operations with exact-width memory accesses, and exclude slots used by vector operations from scalar replacement on the wasm target.
scope: Three alternating fresh Node process pairs per workload/mode, pinned to CPU 2. Update timers exclude setup, checksum and process startup; JIT work in the kernel remains included. All checksums matched, and particle update allocation counts were zero.
conclusion: Do not keep vector values in shadow-stack memory merely to expose SIMD operations. This trial regressed vec2/3/4 particles and the representative physics model. The existing scalar replacement pass normally removes these vops, which explains why changing only the emitter did not affect the particle kernel. Future SIMD work should promote vector values to vector registers; this result does not establish that SIMD itself is unhelpful.

diff --git a/core/compiler/wasm.jo b/core/compiler/wasm.jo
index 2ccdbc0d..85f573e8 100644
--- a/core/compiler/wasm.jo
+++ b/core/compiler/wasm.jo
@@ -57,6 +57,7 @@ const WT_I32 = 0x7F
 const WT_I64 = 0x7E
 const WT_F32 = 0x7D
 const WT_F64 = 0x7C
+const WT_V128 = 0x7B
 
 wt = (vt: int) -> int:
     if vt == VF: return WT_F64
@@ -215,6 +216,56 @@ addr32 = (v: int):
 memarg = (align: int, off: int):
     uleb(wb, align)
     uleb(wb, off)
+# Standard SIMD encodings: WebAssembly/simd proposals/simd/BinarySIMD.md.
+# Short vectors use exact-width loads/stores: vec3 has no fourth stored lane.
+simd_op = (code: int):
+    op(0xFD)
+    uleb(wb, code)
+
+simd_operand = (v: int, n: int, splat: bool):
+    if splat:
+        lget(v)
+        simd_op(0x13)                    # f32x4.splat
+    else if n == 4:
+        addr32(v)
+        simd_op(0x00)                    # v128.load
+        memarg(2, 0)
+    else:
+        if n == 3: addr32(v)             # address for the third lane, below the vector
+        addr32(v)
+        simd_op(0x5D)                    # v128.load64_zero
+        memarg(2, 0)
+        if n == 3:
+            simd_op(0x56)                # v128.load32_lane
+            memarg(2, 8)
+            op(2)
+
+simd_temp = -1
+emit_simd_vop = (ins: Ins):
+    vcode = int(ins.imm)
+    n = (vcode >> 4) & 7
+    addr32(int(ins.a))
+    simd_operand(int(ins.b), n, vcode & VOP_SPLAT_B != 0)
+    simd_operand(int(ins.c), n, vcode & VOP_SPLAT_C != 0)
+    simd_op(0xE4 + (vcode & 3))           # f32x4.add/sub/mul/div
+    if n == 4:
+        simd_op(0x0B)                    # v128.store
+        memarg(2, 0)
+    else:
+        if n == 3:
+            op(0x22)                    # local.tee: keep the result for the third lane
+            uleb(wb, simd_temp)
+        simd_op(0x5B)                    # v128.store64_lane, the first two float lanes
+        memarg(2, 0)
+        op(0)
+        if n == 3:
+            addr32(int(ins.a))
+            op(0x20)
+            uleb(wb, simd_temp)
+            simd_op(0x5A)                # v128.store32_lane
+            memarg(2, 8)
+            op(2)
+
 to_i64_from_i32 = (): op(0xAD)    # i64.extend_i32_u
 restore_sp = ():
     if cur_frame > 0:
